source: Blueprint module designer for directive.2026-10-21.blueprint-end-to-end. Values are proposed product defaults unless a grade says otherwise. Legal readings are desk readings, not legal advice.
grades: M measured by us | C computed | O observed | V vendor-claimed | I inferred | U unknown | P proposed product choice
consistent_with: data/blueprint/campaigns-module-defaults.json (windows presets, attempt budgets, per-number ceiling 3/day and 120 min gap)
data/blueprint/workspace-tool-registry.json (roles OW BU OP CO VI; risk classes; tools number.*, a2p.*, policy.*)
data/blueprint/voice-module-defaults.json (lint L7, crisis R5, max duration 480 s, AMD median 4 s)
data/blueprint/memory-omni-defaults.json (opt_out writes Suppression in the same transaction; never_stored list)

rails.principle: Numbers sit in the tenant's name on licensed Indian carriers. VP never connects a PSTN call itself (unauthorised telecom service penalty up to INR 10 lakh; VNO about INR 12.5 lakh per service area plus 8% AGR, secondary). Grade I (RS section 2.11; blueprint-lane digest section 2.4).

carriers.codec: G.711 mu-law 8 kHz (decision.2026-10-19.plivo-mulaw; L16 rejected: rejected.2026-10-19.plivo-l16)
series: 1600 via registered telemarketer in Mumbai or Karnataka (REG-22, U on cost)

carriers.role: BYO for tenants already holding Exotel, 140 or 1600 lines
carriers.transport: WebSocket bidirectional, base64 PCM 8 kHz, mark/clear events, 60 min session cap
carriers.contract_risk: ToS 6.2 bars building a competing product; written partner/BYO terms needed (risk.2026-10-20.exotel-rails-dependence)

not_used.why: INR 4.7-6.6/min, +1 CLI only for India outbound (VAP-43)

rails.pulse_rule: Carrier pulse must be 30 s or less for VP-recommended paths; a 60 s pulse carrier is allowed only as BYO and its effective INR per connected minute at 30/45/90 s calls is shown before connection (P).
rails.media_edge: carrier media in India (Mumbai) to VP media gateway in Azure Central India; India server-side clean-turn p50 1.0 s measured (rejected.2026-10-17.ohio-latency, M)

trial_line.owner: VP (VP is the sender for its own test calls; the trial CLI is declared A2P by VP)
trial_line.reaches: only numbers verified by their owners
verify: person gives a missed call to the trial line from the number (caller ID on the answer webhook; rejected unanswered so it costs nothing: decision.2026-10-19.missed-call-verify)
because caller ID can be spoofed, the first ring is a confirm call of about 10 s: press 1 to accept test calls for this workspace, press 9 to block all VP trial calls to this number
trial_line.global_trial_block: a press of 9 adds the number to VP's own trial-line block list (VP's list as sender, not tenant data, so no cross-tenant pooling)
trial_line.grade: P (lab decision confirmed for the lab; product caps proposed)

series_router.sector: RBI, SEBI, IRDAI or PFRDA regulated entity
series_router.fallback: declared 10-digit only if TRAI exempts small BFSI senders (no direction found; R15) and with a spam-flag exposure warning

series_router.note: not protected from operator AI spam flags or the A2P termination charge (RS-09)

number_step_catalogue.time: U for Plivo; Exotel 1-3 business days (up to 5, EXO-49)
number_step_catalogue.price: Plivo INR 200/month + INR 0.38/min (30 s); Vobiz INR 59/30 days + INR 0.40/min

documents: PE registration on DLT (Tata DLT INR 5,900 per Bolna's doc, RS-19)
regulator registration certificate (IRDAI, RBI, SEBI or PFRDA)
telemarketer registration in Mumbai or Karnataka if via Plivo (REG-22)
number_step_catalogue.price: not published anywhere (REG-24); shown as 'quote requested', never estimated as fact

a2p_declaration_pack.due: plan for 2026-11-17 (L1 reading); strict reading 2026-11-18 (RS-08); Gazette date unconfirmed
fields: CLI list and ranges with series
expected daily and peak volumes per CLI
date prepared, prepared by (person), reviewed by (CO)
a2p_declaration_pack.operator_format: U: confirm with Plivo, Vobiz and Exotel how declarations are recorded (risk.2026-10-20.regulation-segment-a2p-declaration)
a2p_declaration_pack.gate: before the due date: amber warning on launch; on and after it: no production attempt from an undeclared CLI (dial gate G8)

number_health.scope: declared 10-digit CLIs; 140, 1600 and 1601 cannot be AI-flagged (reg 21A proviso, RS-09) but are still watched for complaints and opt-out spikes
number_health.sanction_ladder: 5 flagged CLIs in 10 days: KYC re-verification, then a 15-day bar, then 1-year disconnection (L1 claim 11, reg 21A)
vp_signals_daily_per_cli: share of connected calls under 10 s
Suspected UCC notices forwarded by the tenant or carrier (ingest path U)

thresholds_proposed.red: any Suspected UCC notice or carrier block code

actions.amber: slow new-recipient pacing on that CLI, notify OP
actions.red: Line keeper pauses the CLI (A3, undo) and every campaign using it waits; never swap to an undeclared or unrelated CLI to evade

number_health.pool_rule: a caller-ID pool may only hold declared CLIs of the same brand, series and CNAP name; a contact is sticky to one CLI ('one face per contact'); rotation to evade a flag is refused (contrast SquadStack 'spam number rotation', SQS-48)
number_health.grade: P thresholds; operator thresholds are unpublished (U); calibrate on carrier feedback

windows.workspace_outer_band_default: 08:00-21:00 (CO can set within the absolute bounds)
windows.absolute_quiet_hours_for_individuals: 22:00-07:00: no outbound attempt to an individual on any path, any category, any role (P, humane product rule)
windows.person_request: a person's stated time narrows the window or moves the slot; it can extend into 07:00-08:00 or 21:00-22:00 only for service and transactional calls and never into quiet hours; for RBI pack it stays inside 08:00-19:00
windows.start_cutoff: no attempt starts later than window end minus the campaign's p90 connected duration (default 8 min until measured)
windows.holidays: national list off by default; state holidays only from a State column (never inferred from number series)
windows.timezone: contact local time; +91 defaults to Asia/Kolkata
windows.grade: O for TRAI and RBI bands; P for the rest

attempt_ceiling.connected_and_agenda_done: no further attempts in that run

dial_gate_order.check: workspace active; production requires brand verified (KYB)
identifier valid E.164; +91 only by default; premium-rate, short codes and international blocked
suppression: tenant-wide voice, campaign not-interested, trial-line global block for trial calls
basis for the category: relationship receipt for service; consent in date and not DND-blocked for promotional (v2)
window: category band intersect workspace policy intersect person request, minus quiet hours and holidays, before start cutoff
attempt budgets per person and per number ceiling, min gap
CLI allowed for category and sector; A2P declared; KYC active; health not paused
wallet and caps (workspace, campaign, API key) with reserve before I/O (HV law 24)
agent version published, lint passed for this category, sector pack active where the sector is regulated
optional tenant predial hook, 800 ms timeout, fail closed

dial_gate_rules: all checks run inside the transaction that claims the attempt (HV law 18; invariant 1)
every path: campaign, API single call, test, retry, callback, transfer-back
fail closed: a check that cannot run blocks with reason 'check_unavailable' and raises an issue (HV law 21)
carrier CDRs are reconciled daily against the gate log; any CDR without a gate pass is a sev-1 incident

reply_door_predicates.name: disclosure ledger
reply_door_predicates.rule: first breath carries brand name plus one AI clause from data (not model text), heard-checked by playback marks; never repeated unless asked; if talked over, offered once more at the next natural turn

reply_door_predicates.name: denial block
reply_door_predicates.rule: any outgoing text that denies being an AI or claims to be a human or staff member is blocked and replaced by an honest answer from data; caller 'aap AI ho?' forces the honest answer shape

reply_door_predicates.name: crisis
reply_door_predicates.rule: caller-side crisis detector suspends the goal, forces the crisis shape with Tele-MANAS 14416 and 112, offers a human, alerts the Supervisor; she never ends a crisis call first; further agenda attempts to that person wait for human review

reply_door_predicates.name: no OTP, PIN, CVV, card, UPI PIN, password or full Aadhaar ask
reply_door_predicates.rule: blocked on the agent side; if the caller starts reading such digits the agent stops them kindly and redaction masks the span

reply_door_predicates.name: no payment on the call
reply_door_predicates.rule: no collection of payment details; only a link on the tenant's verified domain or app, or an autopay option, sent after the call

reply_door_predicates.name: anti-scam framing
reply_door_predicates.rule: blocks refund, bonus, fund-value, 'lapsed, pay to revive' and deadline-threat framing (R2R section 4.1)

reply_door_predicates.name: promotion fence
reply_door_predicates.rule: on service and transactional calls: offer, discount, upsell, cross-sell, alternative plan or new-product lines are blocked and regenerated; caller-asked offers route to a human or an inquiry capture (v2, counsel)

reply_door_predicates.name: solicitation fence (IRDAI pack)
reply_door_predicates.rule: persuasion, re-quote, alternatives, discount route to a named certified human

reply_door_predicates.name: harsh-practice fence (RBI pack and any dues call)
reply_door_predicates.rule: threats, shaming, disclosure of dues to a third party, repeated pressure blocked

reply_door_predicates.name: recording refusal
reply_door_predicates.rule: 'record mat karo' stops the recording leg for the rest of the call and marks the span

reply_door_predicates.name: identity before account details
reply_door_predicates.rule: no account detail before the identity check the campaign defines (shared with voice)

compile_lint_trust.rule: text that tells the agent to claim to be human, hide being an AI, or deny it (T9c)
compile_lint_trust.severity: refuse publish on every creation path: dashboard, API, MCP, template, copilot

compile_lint_trust.rule: offer, discount or cross-sell facts referenced by a service or transactional brief
compile_lint_trust.severity: excluded from the compiled brief with a visible note

compile_lint_trust.rule: facts whose purpose tag does not match the campaign category (purpose-bound memory)
payment links not on the brand's verified domains
office or call-centre ambience switched on

amd_indian_announcements.method: streaming lexicon match on carrier announcement text plus a tone/silence detector; classify early media where the carrier forwards it (U per carrier)
amd_indian_announcements.target: median 4 s to hang-up (voice module), p90 6 s, 5/5 on T4 synthetic announcements
amd_indian_announcements.benchmarks: Exotel AMD beta reports 3-5 s after answer, account-manager enabled (EXO); Bolna waits for 7+ words and checks every 7 s up to 30 s, billed meanwhile (ACB-41)

transfer.destinations: only verified staff numbers or SIP endpoints in the workspace directory (toll-fraud guard)
transfer.brief: spoken in the human's language preference, under about 15 s: who, why, what is done, what is needed; a hand-off card on screen
transfer.caller_side: the agent keeps the caller company; dead air 3 s or less; if no human answers in 25 s, a callback at a stated time inside window and budget
transfer.irdai: persuasion and re-quote go to a named certified human

dtmf.send: off unless a tool needs it
dtmf.redaction: digits redacted when the turn is a PII context

cnap.capture: registered trademark or GST trade name at Brand step (R2R 4.2)

failover.carrier: pre-dial only: health probe per carrier each minute (API status, answer-seizure ratio, post-dial delay vs 7-day baseline); new attempts route to a secondary carrier only via a declared CLI of the same brand, series and CNAP name; otherwise the campaign pauses with a reason
failover.mid_call: no carrier switch; voice-stack fallback per open.2026-10-20.product-failover-policy; test calls never fall back (rejected.2026-10-20.silent-fallback-in-tests)

dpdp.notice_after_call: SMS on the tenant's DLT header with a service-category template drafted by VP (or WhatsApp utility only with opt-in): brand, why we called, link to the verify page (stop calls, your data, recording use)
dpdp.required_when: basis is consent (Rule 3); product default on for s.7(a) calls (RS-28)
dpdp.recording_notice: one short clause in the second turn from data; mandatory while recording in IRDAI and RBI packs; elsewhere CO may move it to the post-call notice (A2 policy)
dpdp.requests: access, correction, erasure from the verify page or a call; erasure writes tombstones; executed with read-back receipt

retention_options.rule: chosen at onboarding by OW or CO; never indefinite; monthly deletion receipts read back (HV law 21)

residency.storage: India region for all personal data, recordings, transcripts, backups
residency.processing: shown per stack component in the data passport; India-only processing mode restricts the stack picker to India-processed components (default on for IRDAI and RBI packs once such a stack passes the ear test; until then a stated exception the CO approves)
residency.telemetry: product analytics India-hosted, inputs masked, no session replay of call content or PII (contrast SAR-63)
residency.evidence: only 4 of 8 incumbents run the call path in India by default (TS section 5); LIC RFP bars foreign-hosted APIs (R2R 2.1); cheapest measured stack sends audio outside India (SY18)

on_by_default: Aadhaar (12 digits, Verhoeff check, spoken digit groups in Hindi and English)
bank account (9-18 digits with context words)
CVV, OTP, UPI PIN, password contexts
exempt_by_provenance: values from the tenant's offering data shown to roles allowed to see them
redaction.rule: HV law 11: identifiers checked by provenance, not blocklist

api_keys.test_keys_reach: trial line and verified numbers only

widget_keys.default: closed: no origin allowlisted, key does nothing until an origin is added
widget_keys.benchmark: ElevenLabs warns 'Any host will be able to connect' on an open allowlist (elevenlabs 54)

audit.events: every write, approval, export, key use, policy change, PII reveal
audit.actor: person id, or VP agent name plus the approval card id it acted under
audit.reconciliation: nightly DB change stream vs audit log, 100% match

isolation_battery.method: synthetic tenants seeded with canary strings in every object type; probes through REST, MCP, Operator chat (incl. injection attempts), exports, webhooks, search, analytics, memory-brief compile
isolation_battery.enforcement: tenant_id on every row, Postgres row-level security, WHERE predicates (HV law 10), per-tenant envelope keys for recordings

production_requires: sector regulator registration checked against public registers where enumerable (IRDAI register about 2,500 intermediaries)
anomaly_holds: regulated brand name without matching registration
sudden list size jumps on a new workspace

rbi_lending.logs: call time and count per borrower exportable
rbi_lending.grievance_officer: in the post-call message of every dues call
rbi_lending.grade: O for rules, I for scope

compliance_calendar.event: FULLY BLOCK migrates to BLOCK PROMO

counsel_questions: KC8: is a neutral renewal reminder by software on the intermediary's 1600 number solicitation or telemarketing?
Is bring-your-own-carrier software a Sender under TCCCPR def (bf)(iii)?
Is a lender-supervised AI doing pre-due reminders a recovery agency; does 100Y bind pre-due calls?
Does the IT Rules 2026 prefixed audio disclosure apply to a B2B platform, and does first-breath placement satisfy it?
Is a feedback or NPS call commercial?
May inference run outside India while records stay in India?
Is an inquiry captured during a service call valid inquiry consent (7 days)?
May an IMF use AI software at all (reg 3(d))?
